requested_outcome: Separate administrator authentication from public customer authentication and render the approved VII logo reliably in both sign-in surfaces.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co/admin and the public VII customer sign-in dialog
authorization_boundary: Diagnose and implement code and tests. Production publication requires explicit approval after verification.

lesson_bundle.reason: The administration system must enforce a distinct role-scoped entry path and deny customer identity from administrator surfaces.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires separate persisted session cookies, separate logout/session checks, authorized and unauthorized route tests, and reload evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported sign-in dialog shows a broken approved brand logo.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires the exact approved VII asset to decode on customer and administrator sign-in surfaces without a broken-image state.

lesson_bundle.reason: A shared authentication component affects multiple routes and roles.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires regression across public customer session, administrator session, logout, callback failure, and refresh behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: The short correction implies an end-to-end identity boundary rather than a cosmetic label change.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires diagnosis at the cookie and provider boundary and visible proof at each natural destination.

lesson_bundle.reason: Any later production release must preserve the current public baseline and rollback identity.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires an exact clean commit, one release, live route verification, and rollback evidence before a publication claim.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Administrator Google login still creates a customer account session or customer UI state.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use distinct signed cookies and omit the public account provider from every admin route.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: An admin cookie is invisible to /api/auth/session and a customer cookie is rejected by the admin gate.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Entering /admin redirects to the customer account page on failure or logout.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add a dedicated administrator login surface and administrator-only logout/session endpoints.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Anonymous, failed, logged-out and forbidden admin states stay in the administrator entry flow.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The logo still flashes as broken or is missing on one sign-in surface.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preload the approved logo and use eager synchronous decoding on both login surfaces.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Cold and warm dialog opens show a decoded VII logo in desktop and mobile layouts.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix logs out or breaks existing customer reviews and profile autofill.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep public APIs on the customer cookie and cover account, review and logout flows with regression tests.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Customer session, review authorization, autofill and customer logout tests pass unchanged.

affected_family: public customer account provider and dialog
administrator layout and administrator login page
Google OAuth start, callback, nonce and failure routes

sources.label: VII accepted authentication and branding behavior
User supplied screenshot of the broken public login logo

midpoint_gate.trigger: After cookie and provider separation tests pass, before styling and broad regression.
checks: customer and administrator cookies cannot authorize each other's APIs
root layout no longer mounts the public account provider on admin paths
administrator entry and logout remain inside the admin flow

attack_questions: Can a customer-only cookie open any administrator route or API?
Can an administrator-only cookie appear as a logged-in customer on the public site?
Does failed or cancelled administrator OAuth land on a customer surface?
Can the approved logo produce a broken-image state on cold mobile or desktop open?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Live administrator entry and public login dialog checked after the exact candidate is deployed.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated tests for both cookie families, OAuth states, logout, analytics classification, customer reviews, and responsive visual checks.

effectiveness.baseline: Current production uses one vii_session cookie for customers and administrators, mounts AccountAccessProvider on admin routes, and the reported customer dialog displayed a broken logo.
effectiveness.target: Zero cross-role session acceptance, zero customer-surface redirects in the admin flow, and zero broken logo states in the tested matrix.
